title: Discount rate boundary allows 10000 (100%), enabling zero-payment yield extraction
description: The setDiscountRate function validates rate > 10000 but allows exactly 10000. When discountRate == 10000, the claim payment formula evaluates to zero: totalNormalizedYield * (10000 - 10000) / 10000 = 0. The claimer receives all yield tokens from all strategies but pays zero reward tokens to Phlimbo. Phlimbo stakers receive nothing.
root_cause: Off-by-one error in setDiscountRate boundary check at line 330. Uses strict greater-than (rate > 10000) instead of greater-than-or-equal (rate >= 10000), allowing a 100% discount that zeroes out the payment formula.
impact: Any NFT holder can drain all accumulated yield from all registered strategies without paying any reward tokens. The protocol's reward distribution to Phlimbo stakers is completely bypassed, resulting in a direct value leak.
